insight: Sold 1.5M+ recorders since 2023 and reached a reported $250M annualized revenue while profitable, on roughly $5M of outside funding.
name: Plaud
tagline: AI voice-recorder hardware + app that turns conversations into summaries and action items.
description: A line of AI voice recorders — the card-sized Note, wearable NotePin and room-scale Note Pro — paired with apps that transcribe in 112 languages, generate structured summaries and action items, and answer follow-up questions about what was said. A desktop notetaker app extends the same pipeline to online meetings. ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR and HIPAA certified.
edge: Dedicated capture hardware goes where laptop notetakers can't — in-person rooms, calls and hallway chats — with 112-language transcription behind it.
pros: Captures in-person, not just online calls
Wearable, card and desktop form factors
cons: Recordings are processed in the cloud

references.title: Plaud launches a new AI pin and a desktop meeting notetaker
